verdict.rationale: Pilot is a managed accounting and bookkeeping service with a client portal, so asking whether users can act on many items at once (for example, bulk-categorizing transactions) is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no user-facing bulk-operation capability. The docs mention a portal, custom workflows and integrations, and community posts describe Pilot's team and integrations classifying transactions for the customer, but none of this is a user-driven bulk action.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
